skills.description: Break questions into a useful research plan and synthesize results.

skills.description: Interpret papers and ground findings in retained sources.

skills.description: Learn from recorded failures and previous experiments.

skills.description: Independently check exact claims and their supporting evidence.

custom_tools.name: Compare experimental conditions
custom_tools.description: A sample reusable recipe for comparing papers.
custom_tools.instructions: Compare materials, experimental conditions and reported uncertainty. Cite the relevant evidence and identify missing details.

workflows.name: Evidence to insight
workflows.description: Research the sources and review them in parallel, then synthesize a grounded answer.

nodes.name: Investigate evidence
nodes.instructions: Investigate the supplied sources and retain evidence for the research question.

nodes.name: Independent critique
nodes.instructions: Independently examine assumptions, limitations and conflicting evidence for the research question.

nodes.name: Synthesize findings
nodes.instructions: Synthesize the connected findings into an evidence-grounded answer. Explain disagreements and uncertainty.

workflows.name: Evaluate and refine
workflows.description: Check data, branch on retained results, and run two bounded rounds of evaluation.

nodes.name: Check research inputs
nodes.instructions: Assess supplied data and research feasibility. Retain a data audit when possible.

nodes.name: Evaluate and refine
nodes.instructions: Evaluate the research question using the connected results. Improve the comparison using lessons from the previous round.

nodes.name: Identify missing evidence
nodes.instructions: Explain the missing inputs and propose an actionable research plan without fabricating results.

workflows.name: Specialist review
workflows.description: A curated scientific challenge with evidence, severity, alternatives, and resolving tests.

nodes.name: Scientific Challenger
nodes.instructions: Apply your curated scientific challenge rubric. Challenge assumptions, methods, evidence, statistical reasoning, and reproducibility. Produce a substantive independent critique, identify missing evidence, and prioritize resolving tests.

workflows.name: Independent council
workflows.description: Independent methods, statistics, and evidence reviews. Compare all three perspectives; agreement is not proof.

nodes.name: Methods Reviewer
nodes.instructions: Apply your curated scientific challenge rubric. Focus on experimental design, controls, confounders, falsifiability, causal claims, and realistic alternative explanations. Produce a substantive independent critique, identify missing evidence, and prioritize resolving tests.

nodes.name: Statistics Reviewer
nodes.instructions: Apply your curated scientific challenge rubric. Focus on independent samples, leakage, composition aliasing, validation boundaries, baselines, effect sizes, uncertainty, and sensitivity. Do not treat generated rows as independent evidence. Produce a substantive independent critique, identify missing evidence, and prioritize resolving tests.

nodes.name: Evidence Reviewer
nodes.instructions: Apply your curated scientific challenge rubric. Focus on whether cited passages support each claim, missing provenance, measurement conditions, reproducibility, and scope of generalization. Produce a substantive independent critique, identify missing evidence, and prioritize resolving tests.
